adapter_requirements.annotation: Explicitly map project target_gene to preset pert_col; preserve canonical target symbols
adapter_requirements.preset: Load the complete preset from the locked evaluator; reviewed settings here are a subset
adapter_requirements.backend: Replace auto only after fixture verification; record the explicit run backend
adapter_requirements.controls: Real evaluation-reference controls define both predicted and observed effects
adapter_requirements.target_exclusion: Whole panel for PDS; own target for other metrics
adapter_requirements.panels: Score each fixed context/panel together; do not average arbitrary subset runs
adapter_requirements.unavailable: Record null, reason, and eligible-group counts

aggregation.expression_metric: Ratio of panel-wide sums, not mean per-target MSE
aggregation.anchor_identity: Require compatible reference bundle and rule version; never borrow anchors across panels
aggregation.context_score: Equal-weight mean of six scaled metrics
aggregation.local_without_anchors: Report raw metrics; official normalized score unavailable
